text: {"name":"sec_table_get_entry","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes the next strided security-table address from a supplied range, updates the cursor and remaining-entry state, and returns zero when no entry remains.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v4":"next_cursor","v6":"indexed_record","v7":"entry_stride","v8":"range_step_count","v9":"entries_to_consume","v12":"remaining_entries","result":"candidate_address"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":19,"meaning":"Remaining-entry count/state; 0xFF is a special sentinel."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Entry stride in bytes."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Cursor updated to the position after the supplied range."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Flag controlling the interrupt/MMIO handling path in the indexed record."},{"offset":132,"meaning":"Per-record offset used to derive the table address."}]}
